l1_words.meaning: to intend or plan to do something

pattern_explanation: Both languages inherited this family of words from the same Latin root, so the spelling stayed close, but the meaning drifted apart over the centuries. Learners who translate by sound alone will pick the wrong English word.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Portuguese verb transliterated as pre-ten-DER looks almost identical to the English verb 'pretend', but it means 'to intend or plan', not 'to act falsely'. Students who match by appearance will wrongly choose 'pretend'.
